Warranty Successful bidder will have to ensure that adequate number of dedicated technical service personals / engineers are designated / deployed for attending to the Service Request in a time bound manner and for

ensuring Timely Servicing / rectification of defects during warranty period, as per Service level agreement indicated in the relevant clause of the bid. 7. Rate Contract The Purchase orders placed through the rate of this bid shall be placed by . The order shall be placed by buyer separately based on the requirement. 9. Rate Contract Packing Material The items will be supplied by the successful bidder in its original packing material and the packing material will not be returned.
